integrity: All infinite-domain claims are proved by geometric edge decomposition, exact integration, and uniform remainder estimates; symbolic/numerical tests are supplementary, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Three boundary-arclength-uniform points of planar rectangles with aspect L>=2; asymptotic L->infinity. No exact total finite-L distribution, no interior-sampling result, and the finite-L remainder bound is not claimed optimal. Historical priority provisional.
title: A logarithmic acute-triangle law for the boundary of a thin rectangle
